stemMd: Which replacement procedure would most directly address the stated risk of losing variation?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Keeping seeds only from one unusually fast-growing parent

options.label: B
options.textMd: Renewing every batch from the same single plant

options.label: D
options.textMd: Measuring room temperature but ignoring parent numbers

options.label: E
options.textMd: Using many parent plants to produce the replacement seeds

explanationMd: The concern is that few contributing parents fail to represent the original variation. Increasing the number of contributing parents directly addresses that mechanism.

distractorRationale.d: The stated risk concerns parent representation.
